reproduces: A card payment step: the cardholder's name, email and phone beside the card fields. The worst false positive this product can produce — an autofill widget offering itself on a payment form — and it was live until the resume probe was scoped to file inputs.
reconstructed: Everything. The field names are the ordinary camelCase a payment form uses. `cardCvv` is the one that matters and it is here verbatim as the shape that broke the gate: `[name*="cv" i]` is a substring test, so it matched the security code and scored this page the extension's strongest form signal. No card number is present as a value anywhere — these are field NAMES, and the corpus guard would reject a real one on sight.

page.text: Payment. Your card details are encrypted in transit. All fields are required.
